design: V7 rotation-only printed pilot: standard 6808 bearing and two PCB screws
material: PETG for four rigid printed parts; purchased metal bearing
service: Remove three cap screws, lift cap while leaving outer retainer below bearing; unscrew inner nut and lift bearing before removing two PCB screws
publication: Local assembly optimization after verified 1.0.25; physically unqualified
cap_style_change: Undo three countersunk screws to transfer the common bearing assembly to another cap
magnet_installation: One diametric diameter5 x1.5 mm disc seated against the integral cap stop at Z12.9; qualify sidewall adhesive after polarity/field checks
pcb_retention: Two opposite M2 nylon screws on four solid posts; two rigid locating collars; physical retention qualification required

bearing.note: Nominal purchased bearing envelope. Confirm race shoulder lands, corner radii, actual fits and magnetic influence with the chosen supplier/sample.

inner_race_nut.assembly_note: Continuous37.3mm fixed-shaft throat gives0.4mm radial clearance for36.5mm PCB insertion; nut is fitted afterward

attachment_ring.supplier: MagnetPrint Hub N52 MagSafe Magnet Ring Kit
attachment_ring.magnetization: Supplier-described one-sided multi-pole Halbach array; working face toward phone
attachment_ring.mounting: Bond one purchased ring assembly into the integrated base; no separate tray bond
attachment_ring.qualification: Nominal supplier envelope only; confirm sample dimensions, working face, peel/shear retention and Hall/RF effects before production

encoder_stop.retention: Seat magnet against integral roof; qualify sidewall adhesive in existing 0.1 mm radial gap; no axial glue layer or loose spacer

print_process.assumption: Provisional generic cartesian printer; actual printer/nozzle not yet confirmed
print_process.cap_orientation: Deck down except thumb_scoop upright with internal supports
print_process.fixture_supports: Required everywhere under retainer fingers; supports may start on the nest pocket floor
print_process.base_supports: Supports everywhere beneath attachment-ring roof and fixed bearing shoulder; remove all supports before installing bearing or magnets

fixed_bearing_support.note: Three rigid overlapping webs join bearing shaft to the base; no sliding joints, press travel or return parts.
